source-note: Classification of agency names from data/domains.json pairs (GSA Federal Website Index) against Section 508 coverage, 2026-10-03. Coverage test: 29 U.S.C. 794d ('each Federal department or agency, including the United States Postal Service') as defined for the Revised 508 Standards by 36 CFR 1194 App. A E103.4 ('Any agency or department of the United States as defined in 44 U.S.C. 3502, and the United States Postal Service'). 44 U.S.C. 3502(1) covers executive-branch departments, military departments, Government (controlled) corporations, other executive establishments incl. EOP, and independent regulatory agencies, and excludes GAO, the Federal Election Commission, DC/territorial governments, and GOCO facilities. notCovered = legislative branch, judicial branch, explicitly excluded by 3502(1), or declared by statute not to be a federal agency. Several notCovered entities voluntarily follow 508 (e.g. GAO, GPO, Library of Congress, House) and the FEC lists a 508 program manager with GSA. unclear = hybrid or branch-unspecified entities. Names not listed are treated as covered. Not legal advice; see research/section-508-coverage-2026-10-03.md for citations.
